raw_text: Chin resistance forces under heavy aerial bombardment near Rihkhawdar. At least two Yak-130 jets involved in strikes. Our contacts in Falam report multiple civilian structures damaged. Refugee columns forming toward Indian border via Zokhawthar crossing point. Situation critical.
clean_text: Chin resistance under aerial bombardment near Rihkhawdar. Yak-130 jets involved. Civilian structures damaged. Refugees heading to Indian border.
